title: GTA 6 Extended Look Dominates Netflix Weekly Charts
description: Rockstar Games' unusual decision to debut an extended look at GTA 6 on Netflix paid off, with the video becoming the most-watched title globally.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Extended Look Dominates Netflix Weekly Charts

Rockstar Games is known for doing things on its own terms, and the studio recently executed an unusual promotional strategy for *Grand Theft Auto 6*. According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, an extended look at GTA 6 made its debut last week exclusively on Netflix before eventually finding its way onto YouTube and other public platforms.

While the subscription service only held a six-hour window of exclusivity for the video, that window proved to be more than enough to achieve massive success.

## A Massive Global Success on Streaming

Data from Netflix's weekly top 10 charts reveals that the GTA 6 video easily surpassed all other content to become the most-watched title globally by a significant margin. Between August 27th and 30th, the extended look accumulated an impressive 31.1 million views.

For a platform primarily known for television series, movies, and original entertainment, a gaming video capturing the top spot with over 31 million views underscores the unprecedented level of global anticipation surrounding GTA 6. It highlights Rockstar's continued ability to break conventional marketing boundaries and capture mainstream attention.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's choice to partner with Netflix for an exclusive window proved to be a masterstroke. Pulling in 31.1 million views in just a few days demonstrates that the appetite for GTA 6 information remains insatiable, and it sets an interesting precedent for how massive upcoming games might handle their initial marketing beats in the future.
